title: Add ExperimentConfig CRD + server-side validation for route experiments
author: Benji Okafor
description: Context This PR introduces the initial ExperimentConfig schema (CRD-style config object) used by the control plane + policy engine to define route-level experiments (A/B/n). It includes strict server-side validation and user-facing error messages that Console can surface directly. This is the first building block for deterministic bucketing as defined in ADR-047. Links Linear: ENG-9021 ADR: ADR-047-deterministic-experiment-bucketing What’s included Schema / model Introduces ExperimentConfig with: metadata: experiment_id, display_name, owner_team, created_by, description (optional) scope: account_id (tenant), environment, route_id(s) variants: variant_id, name, allocation (0..1), target (model_id + optional runtime overrides), enabled flag (default true) assignment: stickiness_key (enum), hash_seed, fallback_key_behavior, allow_missing_identifiers flag guardrails: optional thresholds (p95/p99 latency delta, error rate delta, cost/token delta) as placeholders for later wiring (not evaluating yet) state: draft|running|stopping|stopped (stored, but state transitions are handled in the experiment service PRs) Validation rules (server-side) High-level: fail closed, deterministic, and avoid ambiguous routing behavior. Specific checks implemented: Required fields: experiment_id, at least one route_id, >= 2 variants, and assignment.stickiness_key must be set (no implicit default yet). Allocation checks: allocation must be > 0 for enabled variants; sum of enabled variant allocations must be 1.0 (within epsilon 1e-6). If a variant is disabled, allocation must be 0.0. Variant limits: max 8 variants per experiment (guardrail to reduce config/routing complexity and metrics cardinality). Uniqueness: variant_id unique within experiment; route_id unique list; experiment_id unique within {account_id, environment}. Model compatibility validation (shallow): ensures referenced model_id exists in catalog for the environment and that it is eligible for the route’s modality (chat vs embeddings vs rerank). (Full compatibility checks will be enforced later by policy engine/routing integration.) Stickiness key constraints: only allow keys that are stable and cross-region deterministic (per ADR-047). Valid options in this PR: customer_id, end_user_id, session_id, request_header:<name>. Missing identifier behavior: assignment.fallback_key_behavior can be reject|random|anonymous_bucket. If reject, we return a 400 at config-creation time unless eligibility rules guarantee presence (not yet in scope), so in this PR reject is only allowed if allow_missing_identifiers=false is also set (to make intent explicit in Console). Basic cross-field constraints: hash_seed required if stickiness_key uses request_header; display_name length <= 80; description length <= 2k; owner_team required for enterprise auditability. Error messages Each validation error is returned with: a stable error code (EXPERIMENT_CONFIG_INVALID, EXP_ALLOCATION_SUM, EXP_VARIANT_DUP, EXP_STICKINESS_INVALID, etc.), a JSON pointer-style path (e.g. $.variants[1].allocation), and a concise message suitable for Console (no internal stack traces). Note: response shape is compatible with our existing Console “field error” rendering (same pattern as rollout policies). Storage & versioning Adds apiVersion v1alpha1 + schema version field to enable migrations. Persisted form includes schema_version=1 and a normalized config (sorted variants, normalized floats) to improve determinism across serialization boundaries. Tests Unit tests cover: allocation epsilon behavior, disabled variants, duplicate IDs, invalid stickiness key values, and max-variants guardrail. Golden tests for error messages to ensure Console copy stays stable across refactors. Non-goals / follow-ups Not included: policy engine evaluation (ENG-9022), config propagation/caching (ENG-9023), overlapping experiment validation (TBD; tracked in edge-cases doc), metrics attribution schema (ADR-048), and guardrail evaluation. Migration note This is additive and behind the route-experiments feature flag. No existing customer configs are affected. Release notes Internal only: Adds ExperimentConfig v1alpha1 schema and validation for route experiments; intended for beta enablement behind feature flag.
commits_summary: Commits 1) Add ExperimentConfig v1alpha1 schema + serialization helpers 2) Implement server-side validation + stable error codes 3) Add model modality checks (shallow) 4) Add golden tests for validation errors 5) Wire schema versioning + normalization for persisted configs
ci_checks: Build: pass (20m) | Unit tests: pass (13m) | Lint: pass (4m) | Staticcheck: pass (6m) | Schema compatibility: pass
review_conversation: Jordan Lee (review): The stickiness_key enum includes ip_address in the proto. ADR-047 explicitly calls out IP instability + NAT issues. Please remove before we ship anything to beta. Benji Okafor (author): Good catch — removed ip_address and added a comment pointing to ADR-047 rationale. Also tightened request_header validation to require an explicit seed. Ethan Park (review): Allocation float equality is always a footgun. Can we normalize to integer basis points or at least implement epsilon and normalize ordering? Also please ensure disabled variants cannot accidentally carry non-zero allocations. Benji Okafor (author): Implemented epsilon check (1e-6), added normalization step that rounds to 1e-9 for persisted form, and enforced allocation==0 for disabled variants with a specific error code (EXP_DISABLED_VARIANT_ALLOCATION). Jada Williams (review): Console needs per-field errors with stable paths. The current errors return only a message. Can you add a machine-readable path for each error and keep messages short? Benji Okafor (author): Added error struct with code + path + message. Paths use $.variants[i].allocation format. Also added golden tests to lock wording + codes. Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): Any RBAC implications? Also avoid putting created_by email in config; use actor_id instead to align with audit logging. Benji Okafor (author): Updated created_by to actor_id (string) and moved any user-identifying details out of the persisted config; audit logging will capture actor email separately. Rafael Mendes (review): Please add a guardrail on max variants (cardinality concerns) and make the error message explicit about why. Benji Okafor (author): Added max 8 variants per experiment with EXP_TOO_MANY_VARIANTS. Message: “max 8 variants per experiment (limits metrics cardinality)”. Approved by Rafael after update. Final approvals: Jordan Lee approved; Ethan Park approved; Jada Williams approved. Merged via squash.
merge_outcome: Merged into main; feature remains gated behind route-experiments flag
